case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your quotation; your broad product range is a sound basis for discussing the complete kit. We value the relationship, and our proposed bundle pricing rests on our analysis of the wider account opportunity.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Consolidating the kit under a longer agreement would give you more predictable business through a mutually agreed scope extension. We are flexible on payment terms, including the option retaining your quoted terms; please choose whichever works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.14 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

Which further parts or volumes would make a bundle more attractive for you?

We look forward to building on our work together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Building on your Option B, we are pleased to maintain the 30-day payment terms. Reflecting these factors, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit. 

For our complete proposal, our Angebot is a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that this quote is valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for revising your price, recognising the demand forecast and maintaining the payment terms. We understand that a binding volume commitment, rather than a forecast alone, would give you a stronger basis for pricing.

We have made a modest price concession and ask you to move further in return for predictable business under the agreement. We are flexible on payment terms: Option B retains the terms you have maintained in exchange for a lower price; please tell us which option works best. We can commit to over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.30 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.23 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.25 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive approach and would welcome a complete-kit package with a reliable delivery commitment.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Thank you for improving both price proposals and recognising the value of a longer agreement. Your request for a firm volume commitment is fair; the forecast alone does not establish that commitment.

We are flexible on agreement length, with a longer commitment available to support capacity planning; which option works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.34 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 5.34 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

We appreciate the constructive exchange—let’s keep the paperwork lighter than the fastener kit.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
